proposal.summary: A buffer overrun in OpenSC's pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package can occur when the function scans a malformed ASN.1 buffer with a moved starting pointer, leading to a heap-based out-of-bounds read and possible crash or information leak.
proposal.cwe_quote: This security flaw cause a buffer overrun vulnerability in pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package.

UI.quote: The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context.

C.quote: Further info leak or more damage is possible.

A.quote: In cases where ASAN is enabled while compiling this causes a crash.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain a vulnerable OpenSC build and a crafted malformed ASN.1 smart-card package to reproduce and capture crash/heap-read behavior; request vendor-provided patch or commit that fixes the ASN.1 length calculation and bounds checks; advise users to upgrade when a fix is available.

evidence_quotes.quote: This security flaw cause a buffer overrun vulnerability in pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package.
The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context.
The cardos_have_verifyrc_package function scans the ASN1 buffer for 2 tags, where remaining length is wrongly caculated due to moved starting pointer.
This leads to possible heap-based buffer oob read.

evidence_quotes.claim: Crash observed when compiled with ASAN
evidence_quotes.quote: In cases where ASAN is enabled while compiling this causes a crash.

evidence_quotes.claim: Potential for information leak or further damage
evidence_quotes.quote: Further info leak or more damage is possible.
